payment_plans:
Labelled data: yes: many past plans, each labelled kept or missed
Cost: training once; then each new plan costs almost nothing to run, every week
Risk: a plan picked out wrongly costs a call; a person on the team reviews each plan picked out
Choice: a trained model
Decided by: labelled data, because the team holds many past plans, each with its label, and cost points the same way.
summaries:
Labelled data: no: no store of approved summaries
Cost: nothing to train; a small cost for each call, one call for each new page
Risk: a summary may state a step that is not on the page; the page's owner checks each summary against the page
Choice: prompting
Decided by: labelled data, because there are no approved summaries to train on, and the task is writing text.
